title: UHP Harness Card
description: A Unified Harness Protocol (UHP) harness card describes one agent harness with stable, comparable, verifiable fields. Capabilities are enumerable, never marketing copy.

id.description: Stable slug identifier. Never changes once published.

description.description: One or two factual sentences about what it does. Not marketing copy.

homepage.description: The harness's own website, or null.

github.description: Public source repository root, or null if proprietary.

repo.description: Canonical source repository root (may equal github).

license.description: SPDX identifier such as 'Apache-2.0', or 'proprietary', or 'unknown'.

oss.description: True if there is a public source repository.

source.description: Where this card's data was sourced from.

last_verified.description: ISO date the fields were last checked, or null if never.

capabilities.description: Enumerated capabilities. Use true/false, or 'unknown' when there is no evidence.
